title: (RHBA-2020:1313) Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage 4.2.3 Bug Fix update
portal_summary:
Updated container images for Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage 4.2 are
now available in the Red Hat Container Registry.
portal_synopsis: Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage 4.2.3 Bug Fix update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|4|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258

The Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage 4.2.3 container images provided by
this update can be downloaded from the Red Hat Container Registry at
registry.redhat.io. Installation instructions for your platform are
available at Red Hat Container Catalog.
portal_description:
Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage is a software-defined storage
integrated with and optimized for the Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform.
Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage is a highly scalable, production-grade
persistent storage for stateful applications running in the Red Hat
OpenShift Container Platform. In addition to persistent storage, Red Hat
OpenShift Container Storage provisions a multicloud data management service
with an S3 compatible API.

The updated OCS container images include CVE fixes from Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 on nodejs and on systemd.

All users of Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage 4.2 are advised to pull
these updated images from the Red Hat Container Registry.
